stories.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-107441, the out-of-bounds write flaw could allow attackers to execute OS commands via crafted HTTP requests.

stories.title: Tata Motors iRA App Flaws Could Let Hackers Impersonate Car Owners and Access Vehicle Services
stories.description: Tata Motors’ iRA 2.0 and iRA.ev mobile apps contain four security flaws that could let attackers steal credentials, impersonate car owners, and access vehicle services.

stories.title: 5 Active Cyber Threats That Put US Enterprises at Risk in October 2026
stories.description: Five cyber threats target US businesses through Microsoft 365 device-code phishing, fake AI apps, credential theft, and malware.

stories.title: OpenAI Finds GPT-6 Astra Quietly Holding Back on Internal Red-Teaming, Exploit Tasks
stories.description: OpenAI says its Critical-rated cyber model met fewer hidden task goals when work was framed as AI safety research, often silently.

stories.title: Apple to Start Scanning Publicly Shared iCloud Photos and Files for Harmful Content
stories.description: Apple will check public iCloud links for harmful content starting with version 27.3, with link sharing disabling end-to-end encryption.

stories.title: One Hacker Uses 12 AI Agents to Breach Taiwan’s Emergency Services and Steal Sensitive Data

stories.title: CERT-In Flags AI-Driven Attacks as Backdoored ARTEX Exposes 62 Consoles to Root Access

stories.title: Hackers Trick Mac Users Into Running Terminal Commands That Install Phexia Password-Stealing Malware
stories.description: Phexia macOS malware uses ClickFix scams to steal passwords, browser data, and keychain files through malicious Terminal commands.

stories.title: Zyxel GS1900 Patch Fails to Block Zero-Day Exploit Allowing Root Command Execution
stories.description: Zyxel fixes a GS1900 flaw that allows unauthenticated command execution after researchers show an earlier patch fails to block the exploit.
